newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Credit Lyonnais Belgium sees 1996 profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais Belgium sees 1996 profit growth.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Belgium, a unit of Credit Lyonnais, said profit growth would resume in 1996 after the bank went through a difficult year in 1995.
"After a difficult year in 1995, we're back on the road to profit growth," CLB chief executive officer Philippe Cloes told a news conference.

CLB earlier reported a first-half 1996 consolidated profit of 527 million francs. Full-year 1995 profit was 628 million sharply down from 1.27 billion francs in 1994. The bank gave no comparative first-half 1995 figures.
